title: Kagamine Rin — Card Story

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is everyone having fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I actually brought along someone else today, so that we can make this even more fun for all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let me call her out now!
Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heeey!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, everyone, I'm Kagamine Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, this is fantastic!
You're all so pumped up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll be singing lots of songs with Miku today!
Hope you all have fun with us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are we waiting for? Let's go!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww... Miku and Rin are both dancing so well in this song! They're so cool!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see, move my right hand like this, step like that... Twirl around at the end, smile, and pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... it's a bit hard to see because the screen's too small.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? Why are you staring so intensely at your smartphone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Ha...Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, I was just looking at a video of an event that Miku and Rin took part in...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. You mean the VIRTUAL SINGER event?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! You know about it too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's a girl in my class who's a huge fan of Hatsune Miku. She told me about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, okay. By the way...
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I finished my lunch and wanted to relax in a place without too many people.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm a bit curious about the video you were watching. I don't know much about Rin, you see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: May I sit with you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What song are you listening to right now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A duet between Miku and Rin, with lots of cool dance moves!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm, this is an interesting style for a song...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Rin often sings cute songs appropriate to her looks, but she can also pull off sexy, grown-up tunes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The contrast between her usual cuteness and occasional sexiness makes her so charming...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And she's only fourteen, at that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She has an actual age and everything?
Does she have a birthday too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, I think it was December 27?
The same day as Len's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you mean Kagamine Len?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup. Oh, look! He's in the video too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's finally my turn to shine!
Rin, you weren't holding Miku back, were you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course not! Everyone here can vouch for me!
Right, guys?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You see?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then I can count on you to do the same with me, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
Alright, let the music begin♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The atmosphere there is electrifying...
And their dancing is in perfect unison.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I just saw Rin's stomach...
Actually, Rin has a lot of crop tops, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Her outfit in this video has that design too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm so worried she may catch a cold...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She'll be fine. They're VIRTUAL SINGERS, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... I guess you're right! Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys can still go on, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's amp things up even further!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's finally my turn to shine!
Rin, you weren't holding Miku back, were you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course not! Everyone here can vouch for me!
Right, guys?!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eek! Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it's just Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I didn't mean to surprise you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You didn't seem to realize homeroom was already over, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Homeroom's over?! When?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There wasn't anything important mentioned today, so don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, is that a video of the VIRTUAL SINGER event from the other day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You wanna watch, too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wah, really?
I haven't watched it yet, so it's been on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then let's watch together!
It'll be more fun that way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The song is so bright and cute.
It's perfect for the two of them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I'm a little surprised that they do so well with such idol-flavored songs too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought Rin and Len were more suited for rock and rap songs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but it also could just be that those are the genres I always listen to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Isn't it great that they can sing both cute and cool songs?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, look Minori!
They're holding hands while singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I guess it's because holding hands goes along with the lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right. In this song, Rin and Len are supposed to be twins, I think.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Their setting changes according to the song!
They can be twins, siblings, or even lovers!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't know about that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, guys, the next song will be our last!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's always sad to say goodbye. So let's go out with a bang!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len, you tired? Don't fall behind, okay?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Who's tired?
Make sure you can keep up with me, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Let the music begin!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Looks like...Miku and Co. aren't doing a gig right now. Which means this place is all ours!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's go and ask if they mind us practicing here today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'm sure they'll let us have our secret session!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Secret session?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You know, a secret practice session?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I haven't heard that phrase before.
You're really in the know, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, not at all, hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, I spotted Rin! Riiiiiiin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Someone called me?
Oh, it's you guys.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry, were you rehearsing a song?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll be doing a musical number with Miku tonight, but my dance moves are a bit off...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I was secretly practicing on my own!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, great minds think alike!
That's what we came here for today too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Would you like me to help you with anything?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That'd be awesome, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, first, show me what you've got.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, let's count down and go through the full routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kay! Get ready!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now a quick big wave... Right... Left...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right... Left... Um, was it like this?
I think I got it wrong.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This part is really tricky.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For this move, Airi said to imagine we were pushing against a wall...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't wrap my head around it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, why don't you try it with a real wall?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Stand by this wall and quickly push against it!
How's this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see... Let's give this a try, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aaand...push!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You need to move your center of gravity for this wall-push move.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! I didn't even think of it until now!
I thought all you need to do is move your arms.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shall we try that part of the routine one more time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This time it was perfect!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I feel like something was still missing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah. Your moves were perfect and well-synced but you didn't seem to be having much fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, that could be it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know what was missing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You figured it out? Then tell us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're too fixated on dancing well and staying in sync!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right. All I had in my head was that I had to get it perfectly right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While that's very important, we must not forget that our job is to entertain our audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! You've also got to think of how to make it fun for them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I for one would like to see more of Minori's energy and feel Shizuku's serene expression!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for the pointers, Rin! We'll try it again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This time it was like a dream come true!
It made me crave dancing together with you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'd say your secret session was a great success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's all thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Teehee! It feels great to be able to help!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You helped us notice a really important point we were missing. That made all the difference.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you for letting me watch you practice! Next time could I ask you to help me with mine?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's practice together again sometime! Buh-bye!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad Minori and Shizuku left satisfied and happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why don't you two come out now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You noticed us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And here I thought we were super stealthy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh♪ I've got eagle eyes!
You wanted to check up on Minori and Shizuku, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, they seemed really worried about not being able to keep up with us during practice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been practicing until school closed for the day, so if there was one place they could go to, it was here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So that's how you knew where to find them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Can you tell us what advice you gave them?
They improved so rapidly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm very curious too, since I don't think we were able to give them any useful advice ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're wrong about that!
They mastered the routine following advice from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But they seemed more confused by it than anything, and then they just clammed up...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They probably didn't want to take up any more of your time but needed a while to process it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori's always saying that she doesn't want to be holding you back, that she needs to get up to speed soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that why they wouldn't talk to us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They should never feel bad about asking us for help...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We're all in the same boat, pursuing the same dream together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Besides, I honestly want to do more for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You helped me remember what my true feelings were, and thanks to that I have a goal to work towards. I'd like to give you something back for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel that way, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you know, I think Minori and Shizuku share that sentiment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think that maybe they're practicing so much on their own because they want you to be able to keep taking steps towards your goal, without stopping to wait for them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They want us to keep moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Helping each other's important...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But so is having confidence in the less experienced members. Believing that they'll catch up without us having to slow down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rather than just be supportive, we can show them the way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Be their aspiration.
It'll keep them motivated!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It tickles my pride to be someone's aspiration.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll have to keep running forward at full speed to be worthy ideals to chase after.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, we should do some training of our own!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And think of a new practice schedule for the month.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin. You cleared up our doubts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's good to hear!
By the way, if you ever want to practice just by yourselves, you can do it here if you want.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels great to make a positive change for others! Their eyes were glinting with motivation♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But as for catching up...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I should practice more and do some catching up, too!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, and... Cute pose♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Phew...
I need to work harder for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is it possible to make this part cuter, though?
The pose just now wasn't very striking at all... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Someone's hiding over there?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, three, four, turn here, and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wah?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ouch... Ugh, that really hurt!
I think I injured myself!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-Hey! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Aha!
Now I've caught you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were looking at me practicing just now, right? Why were you hiding, though?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I didn't want to interrupt you when you were practicing. Anyway, how's your injury? Does it still hurt?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nope! I'm fine.
I was just pretending.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Pr-Pretending?! Oh, you...
You scared me out of my wits! Thank goodness you're okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha, sorry about that.
I'm just happy that you're visiting again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, right. I came here to talk to you about something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What about?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: About my future plans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've decided to continue pursuing the path of an idol.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. Minori said something that struck me. She said she would stick to the path she'd chosen without any regrets, come what may.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to have that mindset too. I want to keep walking on the path I'd chosen, just like what I'd been determined to do when I first decided to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So...I'm going to give it another go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright! You have my support, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori wasn't the only one to make me think this way. Your encouragement really motivated me too, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to come here to let you know about it! And express my gratitude, too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, if you're really grateful, come practice with me♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Practice with you?
Of course I'd be happy to!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! So there's this pose in the middle of the routine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, yes. The pose you were practicing just now. It did look a little out of place, like there's something lacking...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yes, I know...
What do you think I should do about it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about...something like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bring your hand up to your face, lift your leg up like this, put on a smile and...pose!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That looks so cute!
Yes, I think I'll try that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's a move from the time when I was still an idol, so it may be a little old-fashioned...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't think so! I think it's super cute!
Okay, I'm going to try it now♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm, I'm shorter than you, so I'll need to make my movements look bigger...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're always so serious about your performances.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I could feel it back when you were trying to cheer me up and right now as well. You're always giving it your all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? I mean, of course I am!
I'm an idol, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to lift up the spirits of everyone who comes to watch me perform! Even my best effort may not be good enough!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, you're right.
That's what being an idol is all about!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll share with you the secret to doing this pose well! Your fingers on this hand should be here... Just a little bit more.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! You noticed something so small?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! This is the best angle to place your fingers for the cutest pose! And that cute pose will bring the best encouragement to everyone watching!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Encouragement to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! I'll master this pose if it's the last thing I do!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, wait.
Shouldn't you be using the other leg for that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah! Urgh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Let's try that one more time, Minori.
I would like to check my steps as well since I'm not very familiar with them yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku... Thank you.
Let's perfect our moves and give Haruka and Airi a pleasant surprise!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'll have to catch up to them quickly, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Minori, Shizuku!
How's it going?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have been improving little by little because you let us borrow this place for practice. Thank you for that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're most welcome!
Say, can I join in the dance practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Step out, hand behind, kick, tap, tap, and pose!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah! Minori, that was perfect just now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you did everything smoothly with no mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did I really?! Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It must be because of the advice you gave me just now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, I'm glad the advice worked, then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still unsure, though. I thought I had improved, but the choreography for this dance has parts that highlight each one of us individually...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's your part like, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Like this.
I'll turn two rounds and glance over my shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! It looks so mature and pretty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Like a furtive glance from a goddess...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, looks like I managed to pull it off, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Both of you have gotten so much better!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: By the way! Can you look at my dance routine too? Turn and...pose♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haugh?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How did you make that pose look so cute, Rin?! Th-That's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my? This pose looks like something Airi used to do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah! Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It is! Airi taught me how to strike that pose just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi's amazing, isn't she? Her dance moves are perfect, and she even thinks about where to place her fingers for the best poses!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know what you mean. Airi's dancing may simply seem energetic at first glance, but she puts a lot of thought into every move she makes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She always tries to think of the best way to make the fans feel more excited about what they're watching...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka said something like that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something about how we'll naturally get better at dancing if we focus on the feelings of those watching us, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not at a level where I can think about such things yet, but I know I want to get there one day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You will!
This SEKAI is the best proof of that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember that this SEKAI was born from all of your feelings?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyone whose feelings were beautiful enough to create this amazing SEKAI can definitely make their dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so strange. When Rin says it like that, it really does make me feel like our dreams are within easy reach.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm all pumped up and ready to take action now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Rin! Can you watch my dance routine one more time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure!
Let's all do what we can to become the ideal idol!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heya, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hi, Rin. Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Have you seen Len?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He hasn't been in yet today.
Are you meeting him here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought he'd be here by now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome to have a seat while you wait.
Can I get you something to drink?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure! I'll take an iced tea!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One iced tea, coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How has L—I mean, how has Miku been lately?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku? She's been giving Kohane and the others a lot of advice on their singing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane is one of the sources of feelings for this SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, she is.
I forgot you haven't been introduced yet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, Len and I were still in the middle of that big fight and I was worried I'd run into him if I came to visit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what are Kohane and the others like?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. They're all very kind.
I get the feeling you have something else you want to ask me, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's written all over your face, Rin.
You want to know how Len was doing while you two were fighting, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hrng... How do you always know, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So how was he?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He wasn't himself for quite a while.
I could tell he was really worried about you the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
Can you give me more details?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, every time he would visit, he would start—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh. Speak of the devil.
Hello, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Len! I've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sorry about that!
I got distracted and lost track of time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're always getting distracted!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So what were you two talking about?
You looked like you were really getting into it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well... What do you think, Rin? Do we tell him?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No way! This is a secret between me and MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, there you have it. Sorry, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! That's no fair! C'mon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not telling! You snooze, you lose!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. At times like these, it's probably best to just leave it alone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then what the heck was even the point of us making up?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah... Sorry, I didn't mean...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I-I'm not mad or anything!
I'm big enough to forgive and forget!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you really okay having me as a partner?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-Why would you ask that? Of course I am.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're the only partner I want.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What about you? Are you okay having me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yes, I want you as my partner!
I can't imagine having anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I would never forgive you if you ever said you wanted to stop being partners!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When you say it like that, it's a little embarrassing. But thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I should be the one thanking you.
I hope we remain partners forever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well don't just stand there all day, Len.
Take a seat. What would you like to drink?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll have a coffee. Oh, and no milk!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What? You can drink coffee without any milk?
Wow! You're like a grown-up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be right back with your coffee. You two talk amongst yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hey. A lot happened while you were gone, Rin. I need to tell you all about Kohane and the others!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, what are they like?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's good to see them back to their regular selves.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome in, you two.
Would you like your usual lemon soda?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, thanks. Len and I were thinking about trying something different today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm going to get some black tea and custard pudding!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll get a coffee.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Black tea with custard pudding, and a coffee.
Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Len. I've been thinking.
What do you think about organizing an event of our own sometime?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Great timing as always, Rin!
I was just thinking about asking you the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The only thing is, I'm not really sure how to go about doing that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me neither. Hm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know! What if we asked Akito and the others to join us? They keep saying their goal is to put on a big event, so I bet they would know how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's a great idea!
Let's try asking them, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to come up with a good set list, too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to make some changes to a few songs so they flow together better, too. Man, the more we talk about it, the more I want to do it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know what you mean! I'm getting hyped just talking about it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet our list will get even bigger after getting advice from the others, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now I'm getting really excited!
Let's make it happen!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here are your orders, you two.
One tea with custard pudding, and one coffee.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you like yours with lots of milk and sugar, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yep. And you... Oh, that's right!
You don't put anything in your coffee anymore, do you?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sometimes. It just depends on how I'm feeling.
I think I'll take mine straight today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm jealous! You look so grown-up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What was the chuckle for, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was just thinking that it's hard to believe you two were having such a big fight so recently.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They say the more two people argue, the closer they are. I think that saying applies perfectly to you two.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The more you argue...?
Yeah, I guess it does.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't usually hold anything back when I'm talking to Rin. I say whatever I'm thinking because I feel like she'll be able to accept it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think I'm the same way.
With Len, I feel like I can act a little selfish and it'll still be fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I suppose sometimes I take it a little too far and it comes out as mean. I'm sorry, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's fine. I should be the one apologizing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, would you like half of my pudding?
Think of it as a sign of us making up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What? Really?
Thanks, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey! I said half!
That's way more than half!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What happened to being close enough that we didn't need to hold back around each other?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's not the same thing!
You definitely don't want to get between me and my food!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There's no need to get so upset.
Look, there's still plenty left.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grr... You even took the part with all the cream on top...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, settle down you two. I'll tell you what.
You can each have an extra dessert today on me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure. Just this once, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, you're the best!
I'll try a piece of the cake, then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll get the fruit tart!
You want to split them, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure! I've been wanting to try the tart.
No taking the bigger half this time, though!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. I promise to be careful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You two really are close.
Just try not to argue too much, alright?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Hrrrmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm glad Airi returned to being her usual self, but I wonder how she's doing now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You gave her all that encouragement, Rin.
I'm sure she's doing perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so too.
We just have to believe in Airi...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But...!
I can't help but worry!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're really so worried, why don't you go look for her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: B-But, if I do that, wouldn't it mean that I don't have much confidence in her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't think Airi would see it that way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure you visiting her would make her feel even happier.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You really think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...! In that case, I'll go look for Airi now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Have fun. See you later.
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I should save these meeting notes.
And this magazine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh, there's so much that I really want to do on top of the stuff I have to do...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But at the same time, being so busy feels pretty good...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd better tidy up and head over to let Rin know what's happened...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiii, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Rin! Perfect timing!
I was just about to head over to talk to you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, you were?
I guess I should've waited a little longer.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I'm guessing you found the solution to what you were so worried about?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did. We won't know if it'll work until we actually try things this way though...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But, thanks to your support, I feel like we're on the right track now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's wonderful...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Airi looks like she's sparkling today.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Airi, I have a favor to ask.
Can I ask you to help me with something?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me? Of course! You've already helped me so much, it's only right that I do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks! Then let's sing together the next time you drop by SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Together... With you, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yup! I really want to sing together with Airi the idol!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it, Rin.
If that's what you want, I'll be there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! Thank you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right! I'll head back to get things ready then!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure. I'll get ready too before heading over!
Tell Miku I said, Hi, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Rin.
Did you manage to see Airi?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup♪ And she asked me to say, Hi, for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, she promised to sing together with me next time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, that's wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It is♪ You were right to ask me to go visit her!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to sing with Airi!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is Airi here yet...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, how many times have you asked that already...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But I've really been looking forward to it!
I can't wait to start already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry. Isn't it almost time too?
See, here she comes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin, I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And Haruka, Minori and Shizuku too...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks for having us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're always welcome!
But what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I told everyone we were going to sing together, they said that they'd come as a cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I've been wanting to try it out for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We rarely ever get to see the stage as audience members, and I thought that might be nice for change.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. And I prepared a few things so that we can cheer you and Airi on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Glowsticks, fans and of course...!
Ta-da! A Happi Coat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have a full set for Haruka and Shizuku too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For us too? Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That sounds fun!
Mind if I join your cheer squad too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course you can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also! I memorized all the right places to clap to the song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be cheering our hearts out, so you two can just go ahead and enjoy performing on stage together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, you're on different level today, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Like a true cheer leader♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright then...
Rin, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! We can't disappoint everyone cheering us on, so let's have as much fun as we can, Airi!
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But we're not done yet!
Our next song is...!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Phew, that was fun♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Nothing beats being an idol!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Airi...
Do you hear that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Encore...! Encore...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we can't call ourselves idols if we ignore such a passionate request!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Let's go, Airi!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! You were 100% right, Len!
Nene's an amazing singer!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She was already amazing when we sang together before, but she's only gotten better since then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know, right? I really wanted you to see the Christmas show too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It was so hard to get a hold of you.
You just wouldn't stay in one place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's because there were so many things I wanted to see♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you know what...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Teehee☆ I discovered something even more awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Nene♪ Have a nice chat with Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu gave me some tickets for the Phoenix Wonderland earlier...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I don't have any use for them, so I gave them to Tsukasa. There were four, and he said he could have his sister and her friends visit us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
That's so nice of you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I really didn't mean anything by that...
Anyway, did you want something from me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right☆ I wanted to tell you that your singing was just SUPERB!♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm? What are you looking at, Nene? I'm over here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(What's she doing? She turned away again...
There's just stage equipment over there.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Is this some sort of a game?
Hehe♪ I'll get her to look at me!
Let's try from that side next!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eek! Listen, Rin...
I don't like being stared at that much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What? Wasn't this your game?
Did I get the rules wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Rules...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Nene's just really shy around people, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She doesn't know you all that well yet,
so she just feels a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't know!
But I want to become friends with you, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I want to sing with you too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sing with me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not that I don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right, you don't like eye contact. But if I'm not facing you, you'll be okay with talking to me, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I'll stand... Right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This works, right? You can't see my eyes now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! That's funny! My turn now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Oh, what are you guys playing? It looks fun!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Let us play with you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure!
Come on, join in♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay team, break's over...
Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, you all seem to be getting along nicely...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-This isn't funny! H-Help!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sigh... That's it for today's practice...
I didn't get to sing with Nene at all...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Don't worry, you can try again another day!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, hi...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, um... I've been practicing my singing at home and in the park...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But when it's just me on my own, I can't tell what I could improve. It would be helpful to have someone come and listen to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I agree! But who are you gonna ask?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rin, you dummy.
She's asking YOU!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to if you don't want...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, no! I'd love to!
I love your singing sooo much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I plan on practicing at my local park tomorrow evening, so do you think you could...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Of course! I can't wait, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll see you tomorrow evening! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good for you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for helping me break the ice with Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm really want to be good friends with her, so we can sing together lots and lots!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Let's have another great practice session, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She seems more comfortable with making eye contact now!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
By the way, Nene♪
Have you been practicing with your new friend?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I haven't seen Hoshino since then, actually...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whaaat?! Why not?!
Didn't you become friends?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We did...
But I forgot to get her number...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, that's terrible!
So you have no way to meet her again?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Don't worry, it's okay.
She goes to the same school as Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Then maybe you can ask Emu for her number!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, she actually offered to do that for me already too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm the one that's trying to make a connection, so I feel like this is something I should do myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Seems like Nene really wants to get to know Ichika better. Maybe there's something I can do to help with that♪)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, look! It's Rui☆Ruuiii, come talk with us♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why hello there... Apologies for interrupting your conversation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to let you know that something urgent came up and neither Tsukasa nor I can make it to tomorrow's rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nene, this is your chance☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're free to go to Emu's school tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! T-T-Tomorrow?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, I was planning to do that some day but...
Not this soon...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
If you're feeling nervous, Nene...
Then I can go with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whaaat?!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So we just keep going this way and we'll find your friend, right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
Emu said she'll be waiting by the main gate.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I'm so excited! I'll keep a low profile,
but you have my moral support!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Did you see something?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It felt like the girls in Miyamasuzaka uniforms were all staring at me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... I stick out like a sore thumb in my Kamiyama uniform...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hey, don't worry about them♪
You're just here to see a friend!
Stay cool, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! There she is♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Um... I'm putting my phone away for now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll be sending you encouraging vibes from your pocket♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Okay, I'm going over to say hi.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... Hi, Hoshino...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for coming all this way. It should've been me making the trip since I'm the one that asked you for singing advice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's okay... I wanted to see what your school was like anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(They both seem tense.
Come on, don't be shy!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Otori already told me.
You wanted my number...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should've remembered to give it to you, but I was so nervous about talking to you that it slipped my mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm really glad you came to see me.
I really want to be friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yay☆
Awesome job, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Did you hear something just now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-N-No idea... What it could be?
L-Let's exchange numbers!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You did it, Nene♪
You can call Ichika whenever you like now!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thank you for your support, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know how long it would've taken me to do this if it wasn't for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe!
You're welcome, Nene♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And I was really happy that I could be there for you too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, can we talk some more while you walk home?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I want to get to know more about you and become good friends with you too!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Me too.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Where am I...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It feels like I've always been here but I was asleep the entire time or something...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's nothing here and it's so quiet...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it's a little brighter over there...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, you found me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. It felt like someone was calling me here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Called here? Mafuyu? The feelings of those that created this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Probably. But that doesn't seem quite right for some reason either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure whether or not that's true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe it wasn't just Mafuyu. Maybe you were called here by everyone else's feelings too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade and the others were able to find Mafuyu here, and Mafuyu welcomed them into this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place may slowly change from being a place where nobody was.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Speaking of which, the ones that created this SEKAI already found their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu. Along with Kanade, Mizuki and Ena...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I was able to meet you here, Rin, because this SEKAI is slowly starting to change.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Did someone else just arrive?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Ena is here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena... Is it okay if I go see her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That might not be a good idea right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on how she was before, she may want to be left alone for a while longer.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku. That just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know. Kanade and the others are here. They're probably looking for Ena.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin. Could you go to Kanade and the others first and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think I know...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think I know whose feelings it was that called me here. I know what I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that so...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, take me to Kanade and the others. I have this feeling that's telling me that I must meet them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Then let's go.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm bored...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How does Miku spend all her time here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Maybe Ena and the others will come here today...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You really can't draw unless someone appreciates your art?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I wonder what kind of art Ena's been making after that.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, it's...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hi, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You came again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Should I have not?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I think you can come here whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wanted to show you my drawing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your drawing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. After that, I talked to Kanade and the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I drew something with the song Kanade made for me in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you brought it here for me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You sang that song for me too, so I thought I should show you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know that's how you smiled.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I'm not...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine, fine. You can't fool me though...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think your drawing is nice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks... I couldn't have made it without you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were the one that refused to give up despite the pain you were feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A compliment like that might throw me off a little...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wasn't really complimenting you. I was just saying what I thought was true.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What you thought was true, huh...? You even sound a little like her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you may be right, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. And I hope you'll keep trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I'm not gonna stop making songs with Kanade and the others anytime soon so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She'll keep making songs with them... From a different perspective, that could be seen as a sort of curse...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But for Ena, that may be a saving grace.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's proof that the bond between Ena and the others are real...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you gonna stay here in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you want me to be here, I will.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean? You won't be here unless I ask you to?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I am pretty busy after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you looked bored a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I doubt I'll be asking too much of you, but I'd feel a lot better if you were here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, I'd feel bad if Miku kept on being alone here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh? You're worried about Miku too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure. She's been helping us too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So... Try not to disappear on me like a certain someone just did with her friends, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, it looks like we will be getting a chance to participate in Project Wonder.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The Smiling Nighttime part of the show that the others will be doing is when we'll be making an appearance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand that we don't have much time to rehearse until it starts, but please make sure to practice safely!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (When Emu came to us looking so sad, I was wondering if there was anything we could do for her...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now, we have that chance! We have to do what we can for her!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay☆
I'd like for us to perform the tap-dance routine that we've been working on just for Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. The plushies seem so excited. I'm sure it's because they're already able to do it flawlessly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (We told Tsukasa and the others that they could count on us. We have to do our best!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hello, Rin? You there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get it down perfect☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Uh, yeah.
I'll start the music then!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They're doing so well☆ It looks even better than before! That means I have to match them...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Yeah♪ Just like this and... *Gasp*...!)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Whoa, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Wahhh!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & B
rows.Line: Squish...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Noooo, what do I do?! 
They ended up breaking my fall!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you two okay?!

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line:
We're tougher than we look...!
Hey, wake up...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry. Are you okay?
Are you hurt at all...?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: I'm okay! But that did scare me a little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
How about you, Rin? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: Haha. You guys became a pretty good landing pad for her!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, you're right!
Anyways, let's keep dancing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! But don't push yourselves too hard, okay? You okay to keep going too, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: S-Sure, let's try that again.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I have to get it right this time...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Wait, what...?!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (My feet... I completely mistimed my step there... How did that happen...?!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin? Did you forget where to step in?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-Maybe... Teehee...
Sorry, just one more time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay. Once more...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Here... I'm supposed to go here and...)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & B
rows.Line: Squish...

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: Uh, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I'm so sorry... I know I'm supposed to step in there, but my body just won't listen to me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I feel terrible. After saying all those things about wanting to help everyone...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, don't worry! We all feel the same way, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everybody here, KAITO and all the others! We all want to help Tsukasa and his friends!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to feel responsible for everything, Rin, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO! Miku too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We came to see you practice☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure what exactly happened just now, but I do know what we all want to help them somehow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You don't have to carry this all by yourself, Rin. We're all working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. But am I really gonna be able to actually help...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's what you're worried about... Miku, a word...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Okay♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ready? One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Miku & KAITO
rows.Line: Hahahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: What's that? Looks fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it too!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Hahahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! What's gotten into all of you...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: C'mon, Rin, join us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hah... Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, more! Show us that beautiful smile we're all used to seeing, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, Rin, together!
One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hahahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Len & Plushies
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright! You did great, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah! But how...?
My feet kept freezing up before we all started laughing together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your mind and body were finally rejoined together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you were scared of making the same mistake and caused you to freeze up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But laughing helped you relax. It put your mind at ease and allowed you to move forward, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, Rin's usually so bright and cheerful, but she had this really serious look on her face just now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not saying that's a bad thing in and of itself. It just may be that Rin does better when she's having fun as opposed to taking something a little too seriously.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you're all better now, right☆
You looked like you were having a lot of fun during your performance just now too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Miku, KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'm so sorry, plushies. You too, Len. I promise not to take things too seriously or try too hard from now on...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. That sounds a little weird, but okay!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*... There's no practice today, but there's also nothing to do...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I know what you mean. Then again, there are those of us who aren't affected by any of that♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha♪ Another lazy day for Luka☆
But I'm so bored...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aha! There you are, Rin♪
Yahohoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu, wait...!
Luka's sleeping so try to keep it down...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't mind her! It takes a lot more than that to wake her up...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, you're right... How can anyone sleep through all that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But what brings you two here today?
Are you here to play and have some fun?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's also been quite a while since we last saw each other, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. With Project Wonder succeeding, more guests visiting the park and becoming its ambassadors kept us really busy for a while.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been wanting to say thanks for what you did for us too. That's why I asked everyone to take some time to join me here♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rin, MEIKO, Luka... Thank you so much for all your help!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe☆ You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, it was super fun for us too! I mean, it was such a huge show since every single troupe was actually in it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think Luka likes it too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... You're sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Positive☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. That's good then.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, also... There's something else we wanted to show you... Here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your phone? Oh, it's a video?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. A ton of people recorded videos of this show and put them online. They created a lot of buzz and even included this... See?

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: <And so, this park helped bring happiness to everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, that's my voice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Here's the part where you all sang and danced too...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Look, it's us♪
Hehe. I didn't know that's how I looked when I'm singing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! You can even hear something else too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hear what?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have to listen very closely...

rows.Speaker: Kid's Voice
rows.Line: Mommy, let's dance with them!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sure.
I'll try my best, okay?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, they're all laughing...
You can tell they're all having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone that's watching you has an extra sparkly smile on their face too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, it's pretty hard to see all their faces in these videos...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it really did seem like they were genuinely having a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so great...! Hehe☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... That was quite a lovely smile too, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks... L-Luka?!
You're awake?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I was awake the entire time. Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, you were definitely asleep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, Emu's smile's sparkling too!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I'm so glad...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good for you, Rin.
The person you've been meaning to cheer up most is smiling like they mean it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Emu's even turned your frown upside down!
It's an incredible thing, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? She turned my frown upside down?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's something KAITO told me when I first joined his troupe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By being in a show, your smile can make your friends and so many others smile. Those smiles can even come back again full circle to put one on your face!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's so wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Shows make people smile...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It really is like magic...!
I feel so moved by that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really loved doing shows to begin with, but being in this troupe is making me love them even more...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What you just said really rang true with me, MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All these people are tied together by the shows they see and their smiles! It's super wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's keep doing lots and lots of shows, and make lots and lots of people smile♪
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The front entrance is over there and this corridor takes me to the teachers' office...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! This whole SEKAI's just one big school!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But Miku-P and the others don't really seem like teachers... Come to think of it, there's no one like that here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That means...
I can do whatever I want?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hahaha♪
Nobody will get mad at me for running around!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm? That sound...
Oh, could it be...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see. It sounded like it was coming from this classroom...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Time for a quick peek!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Luka and MEIKO! Also...)
