rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I guess I have no choice but to give up on my tree idea...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm? Rin?
Why the long face?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh no. Your cute face shouldn't have a frown on it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
KAITO! MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-I'm okay, really! I was just getting myself pumped up to practice for our spring show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We see right through you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! I-I'm not lying!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But your eyes are moving all over the place. You still seem to refuse to make eye contact with us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, I was just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know you can tell us if there's something bothering you, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I'd probably just end up being a bother...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's the tickle monster...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Eep! Hahahaha!
MEIKO, stop! That tickles! Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What did I say about frowning with such a cute face? C'mon, give us a smile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-MEIKO! Hahaha!
I... I can't breathe!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't you tell us what's on your mind as you laugh yourself silly?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha! Okay, I'll talk!
So please, stop tickling me...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. You're wondering if we can somehow put together a cherry blossom tree prop.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that a tree would give our show a much more springlike feel.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... I can't imagine how hard it would be to put one together right now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really don't want to be a bother since I already asked you guys to help me look for cherry blossom trees...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A bother?
I think you're jumping to the wrong conclusion...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, why do you want to have a show under a cherry blossom tree so much?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why...? Because it'd be so much prettier that way, and our fans would be totally blown away by our show if we did...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In other words, you want to have a cherry blossom tree to make this show as good as it can be!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In my book, that doesn't make you a bother at all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. Also, you won't know if it's possible until you ask everyone about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've come up with a wonderful idea, so we should definitely ask the others to hear what they think♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it might be good to have some illustrations ready to go along with your explanation. Why don't you draw a simple set design for us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! I'll give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I think the stage would look really incredible if we made some cherry blossom branches like the ones in this sketch...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wh-What do you guys think...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It won't be easy even if we started right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I do agree that the stage will look absolutely gorgeous♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd love to sing on a stage that's covered in cherry blossoms like the one you drew, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, let's give it a try.
Rin, we'll make such amazing props that even Minori and the girls will be left speechless♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku! Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO, MEIKO, I take it that we'll be able to make these in time since you both seem so optimistic about this endeavor?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. It'll be all hands on deck, but we should have enough time to pull this off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we won't know until we try.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, the theme for this show's “a new side of us”...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think that should include both our performance and the stage. Wouldn't it be great to show everyone how both have evolved?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's start hammering out the details and figuring out our assignments.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, does this color seem about right for our cherry blossom branches...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We made some look a little darker as a little test! What do you think? They look pretty real, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's fantastic!
These look just like real branches.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! We did it, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line: Up top♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO! Everyone!
Mind looking this way for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Look what we found! The white lace curtains we used during one of our other shows♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How about we dye this light pink and cover it with some of the cherry blossoms you've all been making?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We could hang this up alongside Rin's branches too. That way, it'll look like the cherry blossoms are gracefully wafting in the breeze.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! That'd look so pretty!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! Let's give it a shot, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure, but let's check to see if we have the materials necessary to make some extra cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku let me know what's going on and I just checked our stock.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Surprisingly, we should have more than enough to use on these curtains.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I really appreciate it, Len!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All that's left is for us to do everything we can to make these!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure we'll be fine since we're all very good at putting our best foot forward♪

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The branches are done!
Now we just need to put cherry blossoms on them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The curtains are a lovely pink now too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hey! Anyone free?
We need some extra hands making cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Wow...! This is so amazing...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I didn't think it was possible, but this set's really coming together!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I never realized that we could do so much when we work together like this!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
KAITO!
I'll help make cherry blossoms too!
The day of the spring show

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori and the girls should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I hope they like the stage we all helped put together...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello!
We're really looking forward to today's show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa...!
L-Look at the stage! It's covered in cherry blossoms!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that a cherry blossom tree? No, wait, it's a line of trees...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe you're right. There are so many cherry blossom branches hanging down from the ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And that curtain's gorgeous!
Look how pink it is...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're enjoying our surprise♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was Rin's idea to set up the stage like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Rin, this was your idea?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um, well... My idea was that you and everyone else would like it if we did a show under a cherry blossom tree...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it was only possible to get so many trees set up because we all worked together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There was no way I would've been able to do something like this on my own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You came up with a wonderful idea, so we felt compelled to help make it a reality.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly! It became more and more fun as we kept building everything too. We even managed to come up with some improvements along the way♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. And before we knew it, our stage had turned into this extravagant sight.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'm really glad we went through with this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. Especially since “a new side of us” is our theme for this show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's do the spring show together on this cherry blossom stage♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We get to perform on this incredible stage? I must be dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right?! We gotta do our best to put on a show that does this stage justice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Before we start the show, can we take some time to look at all the cherry blossoms...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Of course.
You can come up this way. Follow me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like they all like your idea very much, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All that's left is to make all of our fans feel the same way during our show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'm gonna do my best to make that happen!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...!
And... A great, big smile♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'm getting the hang of that new dance now. I can't wait to practice it with Minori and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They're still trying to help the girl that's writing their new song for them...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hmm... I told Haruka pretty much everything I could, so I hope things are going well...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Perfect.
There's something I need to tell you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Did something happen?
If you need to talk, I'm all yours.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
But I'm not here to talk today. I'm here to invite you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Invite me?
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow...!
This place is massive! So many people too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Uh oh...! I probably shouldn't speak so loudly, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should be fine. There's enough going on around us, and we'll be sure to keep an eye out for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. We want you to enjoy yourself and have a fun day out shopping with us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really...?! Thank you all so much!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I still wish you could've been there to see Mai's show with us, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<No, it's okay.
Haruka even said that it wouldn't be easy to keep her phone out the entire time.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I've been super stoked about going shopping with all of you♪ Where do you wanna go first?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. How about...?
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa...! This place is really big too! Also with lots of people!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh no...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I did it again...
Did anyone see me? Are we okay?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're fine. Again, there's plenty going on here anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Phew... Thank goodness.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Still...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Look at all the shops...!
Oh, what's that one?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's a decor store.
They sell all sorts of fun goods and trinkets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, you could be a little more descriptive...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It'll be quicker to just see for ourselves, so let's check it out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh wow! Hey, why's this cat taking a bath?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That looks like a humidifier that doesn't require electricity. Apparently, it'll humidify on its own after you pour in some water.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, how about these really fluffy clothes?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I believe that's loungewear.
Oh, look at that. The hood's a cute bunny.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Minori
rows.Line: <That's adorable!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What about that other fluffy one?
The hood looks spiky...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This one's... Oh, it's an alligator.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Airi
rows.Line:
<A-An alligator?!>
A-An alligator?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad we managed to get our hands on some nice accessories.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can hand Miku and the others the souvenirs we got them the next time we're in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, sounds like a plan♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Where would you like to go next, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? You're really okay with me picking where we go?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been here a ton of times already, so we should go where you want to go today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Also, we can't help but smile when we see you having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? Why's that...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We decided to take a day off to have fun, but we were worried that we wouldn't be able to actually enjoy ourselves today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's hard not to think about Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. I'm still really worried...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But you said so yourself.
“How can you save someone when you aren't feeling very good yourself?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're able to have a fun day out shopping today because you're smiling and genuinely having a good time, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. That's good to hear...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Alright, let's have even more fun♪
We're all gonna be smiling from ear to ear!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, why don't we head to our next stop?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo!>
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think Haruka and the others are gonna visit today...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... We didn't make any plans to practice together today, so they might not.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They all really seemed to enjoy themselves when we went out shopping the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But I keep wondering how the girl writing their new song is doing...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: As worried as I am, I still have a dance routine that I need to practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean the new one that you said you were finally getting the hang of?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. But there's this one part that keeps giving me trouble...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hi, Rin! Hello to you too, Miku.
Sorry for not getting a chance to visit sooner.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you were worried after everything I told you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
N-No, I wasn't worried at all...!
I always believed that you'd all be just fine!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Even though you were anxiously awaiting Haruka's arrival just now, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? M-Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Rin... You too, Miku...
Thank you for showing so much concern for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You made it possible for me to tell the girl writing our song what I wanted to say.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. As a result, she began feeling a little better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good for you, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Also, Rin.
I'd like to repay you for the advice you gave me. Is there anything you'd like me to do for you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Repay me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
What I'd like you to do for me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, why don't you have her help you with that dance routine? Weren't you just about to keep working on it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great idea! Especially since Haruka's such a great dance teacher!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Haruka, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's do a quick run-through based on what we just discussed...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One... Two... Three... Four...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Is it me or did Miku and I fall out of sync when you said, “Three,” just now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, when you tilted your bodies.
Rin, stay still and hold that step for me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On three, if you have all your weight on your right foot, it's going to be hard to transition to the next step.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. It seemed like just a timing issue when we were standing next to each other like this, but it was really a matter of weight and balance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. On three, try putting your weight on your left foot and move your right foot back slightly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And gently bend your left knee while in this position.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! My right foot moved forward all on its own!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Having your weight shifted in the right position like this should make it easier to move to the next step on the count of three. Not only that, but you'll make fewer mistakes and be able to present yourselves better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, weight and balance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Haruka!
I'll keep that in mind as I practice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, mind seeing how I do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
One... Two... Th...
No, my weight's on my right foot again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That just may be what feels most natural now after practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. Just take it slow as you try to shift your weight into the right position.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Left foot... Left foot...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One... Two... Th... W-Wah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Rin?
Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you twist your ankle?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay!
Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, one more time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Miku and Haruka are really going out of their way to help me with this routine.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I couldn't ask for better support♪)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I want them to smile, so I've gotta keep trying my best!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... I... I did it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice job, Rin!
That was great!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All that's left is to adjust your tempo to match the music and you should be dancing beautifully in no time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you so much, Haruka, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. Minori and the others are going to be here soon to practice, so why don't you lead this part for them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The truth is, Minori's having trouble with the same exact part.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But she's really close to getting it right, so I'd really appreciate it if you could give her that extra push over the finish line...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yeah, you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna get this part down perfectly before the others all get here♪
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Even though I already saw it once before, that DVD of RAD WEEKEND was still mind-blowing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it was. Hearing that Nagi person sing made me want to sing as well!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, An told us a wonderful story.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It really was.
And we got to learn more about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's just... I feel really confused now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Confused about what?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: About RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An's dad and his team put on this amazing event with that Nagi person at the center of it all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The atmosphere they created with the other teams was also important...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The same goes for “taking a look at the city”...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Argh! It's just way too much to think about!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I kinda feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? I don't think it's that difficult.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just think of them all as things that need to be done in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that makes it so much easier to understand!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't oversimplify it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, we'll just have to take it slow and try to tackle one problem at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take it slow, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case, I want to learn how to feel the air or atmosphere a little better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For example, are things really that different when we're all singing together here versus when a bunch of teams are singing together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course it's different. I mean...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, hold on...!
Words alone likely won't be able to provide a satisfactory answer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, Len, mind taking a quick trip with me after this?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A trip?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, a trip? That sounds fun!
I'd like to go too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I assume they're heading over heading over to other side.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's also my guess.
I really hope they don't cause the others too much trouble...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're here...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, Rin, hi.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't forget us!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Including me!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What brings you all here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's something we'd like to ask all of you!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, we'd like you to let us watch a battle in order for us to get more experience feeling what an event's atmosphere is like.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Feeling an event's atmosphere, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We want to learn how to feel the atmosphere at these things better!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If we do that, we'll be able to help you guys out with the next event you put on, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, KAITO suggested that we try to find ways to feel the atmosphere at lots of different events.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If that's the case, you can count on us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Incidentally, we're gonna be in a battle event soon. We'll make sure to let you guys know when it happens!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Um... Will it be just the four of you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I believe so. MEIKO and the others seem to already have a good grasp of this stuff.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! We'll look for a place where we can keep two of our phones hidden so you guys can watch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dropping in to watch is fine and all, but don't let anyone see you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<We know!
We were fine the other day, no?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! You guys are so awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I just heard someone's voice just now... Coming from over there, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: What? It's all just spare amps and speakers over there. They aren't even plugged in so, there's no way they could've made a sound.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <To be honest, that was a close one...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Shush!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Anyway, we're really looking forward to it!>
Live House

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're here...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, heya, An!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <N-Not so loud, Rin!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Len, you're being just as loud!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're being the loudest of all, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. My apologies.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry too much since they just opened the doors to let the audience in and they're all chatting pretty loudly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, you're right. There's a ton of people here!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys mentioned that you wanted to get a better feel for the atmosphere, so it'll be important to see what it's like to both put on an event and be in the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: This event's got such a good lineup! Just famous teams left and right!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah, especially Vivid BAD SQUAD. They've been on a roll since successfully putting on their own event.

rows.Speaker: Spectator C
rows.Line: No way, dude. If you want a team that's on a roll, you gotta think...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa...! They're all really excited about this event!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll need to do our best to make sure they enjoy everything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we should head backstage soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we can leave them here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you, An, Kohane♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Good luck with your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll come straight back once we're finished.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Have fun!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Just a little bit longer until it starts.
I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Me neither. I'm glad I decided to join you all.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <By the way, Rin, how do you feel? Are you getting a good sense of the atmosphere?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Good point. The calm before the storm's very important.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Try looking at all the teams standing by in the wings to perform. Keep in mind that people are the ones who have to create a good atmosphere.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The atmosphere's...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <...created by people.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Remember that Nagi person's performance?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, that's right!>

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team A
rows.Line: This event's just wall-to-wall A-listers...

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team B
rows.Line: Hey, now's not the time for that! Remember how long it took us to get here!

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team C
rows.Line: Right! If we can get the crowd on our side at an event like this, we'll start getting instant name recognition!

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team A
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We're in the neighborhood where that legendary event happened, so we gotta do everything we can to achieve that!

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team B & C
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team A
rows.Line: Looks like we got some good ones today. I've never seen them before, but we should keep an eye out to see how they do.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team B
rows.Line: But Vivid BAD SQUAD's gotta be the favorites for today...

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team C
rows.Line: Yup. This is our first time performing in an event with them, since we were in a different city for a while...

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team B
rows.Line: We used to perform around here a lot too, but they're the ones everybody's talking about now.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team A
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's take this opportunity to remind them that we're also here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Th-This is getting kinda scary...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It is a battle after all. Isn't this sorta normal?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, right. This event's a competition.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Exactly. The atmosphere that's created here should be fairly different from the event that Akito and the others put on, as well as from RAD WEEKEND.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Since everyone's singing with different goals in mind.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Different goals...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Remember what the people from that one team were saying? They want to get their name out there.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thus, it's only natural for most teams to go into this event believing that they'll be able to sing their way to the top and say in the end, “We're the best!”>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That explains the tension in the air...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <At the same time, you'll only feel that tension right now.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Once the event starts, each team will do their best to get the crowd on their side and turn the tides in their favor.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I think it's about to begin.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I know you've both been looking forward to this event, but try not to forget that we're here to get a feel for the atmosphere, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <K-KAITO's acting like a real teacher...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Ouch.
I can put on a serious face when I need to...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha! But your actions leave so much to be desired most other times...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Speak for yourself, Luka!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Quiet, you two!>

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: <S-Sorry...>

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Haha!>
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I hereby declare this meeting to discuss our strategy for the girls' training sessions open!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay...? You know we're not here to play around, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We may actually come up with some nice ideas if we do try to have fun with this like her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... Shiho asked us to teach her and the others how to play their instruments better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. She said one-on-one sessions would be preferable...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But... Who's going to be looking at who?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's the issue at hand.
There are six of us and only four of them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, two of us are gonna get left out! That'd be way too sad!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, why don't we have those two move around freely?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Move around?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, they could roam between groups to see how everyone's doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that's a nice idea. I was just thinking one of us should sort of oversee everything.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I see... That could work...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However... I probably shouldn't be the one...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO, why not?
You seem like the one who'd see things the most objectively.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each of the girls is going to have a tutor assigned to them, yes...? As they train and work together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In time, their bond will grow stronger...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. That means our trust in one another will also increase.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. As nice as that may be...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can handle practicing with someone like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You sure? I have a feeling that you'd do fine since the goal of this is to make them better performers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In any case, let's start thinking about who's going to be assigned to who.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to lead off by saying Honami asked me for some help, so I'd like to be assigned to her if possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd like to work with Ichika or Shiho. We already do a lot of sessions together, and know about each other's habits and tendencies.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm in the same boat.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm okay with anyone♪
It could be really fun to move around and see how everyone's doing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm.... I'm also okay with anyone. I can't really think of a good reason to be assigned to a particular person like you guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, KAITO, how about you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... I'm not sure I have a strong preference either...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Saki's still on the table.
If anything, I think Rin should be assigned to her since they get along so great.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right...
However, in terms of training, there is one thing that's bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're all essentially able to play any instrument... That also means we don't specialize in any particular one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true...
I like playing certain instruments, but they're not necessarily my specialty...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm also worried about one person teaching someone for two weeks straight since they'd only be exposed to that tutor's style and knowledge...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... You bring up a good point.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, it's not a good idea to have the same teacher the entire time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we shuffle around?
You could be assigned to one person today, and someone else tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, don't kid around like...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Actually, that might be a really good idea...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. That way, one person's teaching style won't dominate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. And as long as we report to each other what we do each day, we'll know how the girls are progressing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Also, even if these training sessions do get really tough, they'll get have some fun wondering who's going to be assigned to them for the day♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Definitely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'd be easier for me if I were assigned to only one person...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, it would allow us to be ourselves...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We all see things from different perspectives, which should greatly benefit Ichika and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, does that mean...?!
We're going with my idea?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! Do the tutor shuffle!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, now we need to discuss who's going to be assigned to who first!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I didn't realize just how serious you all were.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though you played as hard as you could today, I wasn't willing to listen...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm gonna play like I mean it.
So, let's make our next performance one to remember...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try to keep up with me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Keeping up with Shiho isn't going to be easy, is it...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this is just the first day.
For now, let's keep watching over them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you that worried about them Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
There's that, but also...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's so hard to be kind and thoughtful to someone in just the right way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: H-Hang on... Am I the only one who feels this way?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry.
I didn't mean that in a condescending way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we both felt that we all seem to think the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The same way...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember that story from the other day about what happened to the girls after they reformed Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like they were scattered to the wind. They didn't even talk to each other much at school.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing how they are now, I can't imagine that at all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even after that, on more than one occasion, they've sort of butted heads after trying to reach out to one another.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Their becoming so distant from each other was also because they believed that's what was best for them, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But their thoughts and feelings are what pushed them to reform their band, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, what did you mean by more than one occasion?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, have we not told you about what happened at the choir recital?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Choir recital?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. That happened just around the time I arrived here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see, so you were fretting about something that happened in class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was really trying to think things through with me. Saki saw that I was feeling down and wanted to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho said some harsh things too, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There are many different ways of expressing kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can empathize with someone who's troubled about something, make them smile or be somewhat direct.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As long as it was done with that person's best interests at heart, no matter what form it takes, it's a form of kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's also important to consider how the other person will take it too, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Different ways of expressing kindness...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami became so worried that time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, Shiho was beating herself up about saying some really harsh things to Honami again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those two express kindness in such different ways. You could even say they're polar opposites in that regard...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes... Honami likes to wrap you in her kindness, while Shiho's kindness involved being blunt and telling you the cold, hard truth at times...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. I can't say if that was the main reason, but they did also manage to clear their ticket quota.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, didn't that happen when Len and I were having a huge fight...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The girls care about each other very much, but they experienced a period when they weren't all together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As a result, despite their intentions, having strong feelings for one another can lead to disagreements...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To be fair, the road to true friendship is paved with fights and arguments.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len told me not to push myself too hard for the same reason...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Fights and arguments are natural outcomes of wanting the best for one another.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Kindness is such a deep subject...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Secret training?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I made a promise with KAITO, so I gotta go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair!
Why didn't you tell me about this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It'd stop being a secret if I did...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, he's gonna teach me how to mix today one on one! Later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now what am I supposed to do?
I guess I can just wait at MEIKO's place...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it sounded like he was gonna be gone for a while... If I spend all that time having juice and stuff, I'll look like a stuffed pig by the time he gets back...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there someone I can hang out or practice with...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Alright, I'm here!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <An and the others are probably practicing right now, so they should be okay with me joining them!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hang on... I've never heard this song before. Also, why is everything shaking?>

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Things are gonna jump out at you... But they're not real... They're just people... It's okay... They're just people...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<That voice... An?
But she doesn't sound like her usual self...>

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Geez, how long are you gonna keep doing that? You know none of that's gonna work, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
That's not true!
As long as I keep reminding myself that they're not real, I won't be scared of them! That also goes for ghosts!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Oh...? They say that real ones are attracted to people who think that way.

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
*Gulp*
R-Real ones...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<They're talking about ghosts...?
This is getting interesting. I think I'll keep listening!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, don't be so mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I wouldn't put too much stock into what he says, Shiraishi. As some say, “fear makes the wolf bigger than he is.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Really...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-That's about how things aren't as scary as they seem, right...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, exactly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've read mystery horror novels about strange phenomena that occur in haunted houses...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And those sorts of things tend to happen in locations that have historical significance or where tragic events have occurred.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miya Girls is a school with a long history, but I'm not aware of any ghost stories or infamous incidents that involve it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I have a feeling that there's a low chance of you encountering anything unwholesome at this haunted house.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But not zero...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I just thought the same thing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm not an expert on the supernatural, so I can't eliminate that possibility.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't care if you lie to me! Just please tell me that there's no chance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Geez, relax, will you...?
I mean, you don't have to go if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! No, I have to go!
I promised Kohane that I would!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So... E-Even though Kohane's class is doing a haunted house, I have to put my life on the line to go see it and her!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She says with such confidence...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The School Festival? A haunted house...?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right! They're gonna go see what the School Festival is like at Kohane's school!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! I hit the bullseye with this one!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Did anyone else hear that voice just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I heard it too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?! H-Hang on...
What are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we really heard a girl's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Quit pulling my leg.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, we don't wanna be late to see Kohane, do we? Actually, what time is it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hey, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. It's just me!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
R-Rin?!
Geez, you had me going there for a second...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I was bored, so I was hoping that we could practice together!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, I heard you guys talking about Kohane and the School Festival. That's where you're going, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Can I come along?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you did show quite a bit of interest when we told you about Kamiyama High's School Festival...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Exactly! So, can I go?
I promise to not be seen by anyone!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're gonna come even if we say no, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yup!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I beg you guys! Take me with you!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These opportunities don't come up that often. So, why not?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. If Kohane were here, she definitely would've been the first one to say yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Rin, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! Thanks, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you can't be seen by anyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I won't!>
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wow!
That all really happened during the School Festival at Kohane's school?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! And she ended up chasing An all around the school because she couldn't get that wolf's head off!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, don't laugh!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I heard from Kohane and the others earlier, but it really must've been quite an ordeal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... She ran into a class that was running a cafe, which scared all the customers...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And after that, she ended up being a part of a play by accident?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I was doing my best to help guide Kohane, but we were having so much trouble catching up to An...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't she so athletic that the other sports clubs are always asking her for help?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, if a girl like that decided to run at full speed, catching her's never going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But Kohane's friends and classmates all helped you find her, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! This other girl from Kohane's class borrowed some tools to get the wolf's head off.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, An finally realized that it was all just a big mistake! After that, we got to actually enjoy the festival!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see, so all's well that ends well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No fair.
I wish I could've gone...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, but it serves you right for leaving me behind to go train.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's settle down. It's all in the past now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. Why don't I make some of the food and drinks that appeared in Rin's story? What would you all like?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You mean it?! Then, yakisoba!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to try those pot sticker cookies!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, the sushi sweets also caught my interest.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay... Pot sticker cookies and sushi chocolates, right? Wish me luck. Those may prove challenging...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... If anything, I'm more interested in how they're put together.

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, coming up with your own shop or attraction has to be a lot of fun, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'm curious as to how that process works.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank goodness. That's what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Why do you all look so surprised? Did I say something strange just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha... Don't mind us...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, Miku, what would you like to have done the most during a School Festival?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to know as well!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I haven't really put much thought into it, but putting a maze together sounds fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A maze?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Think about it. Don't most of us enjoy wandering around the back alleys of this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I thought it'd be fun to have others experience that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. That does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As for me, I'd like to run an ice cream stall!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good for you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, you could show a little more interest! Anyway, Luka, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me? Well... I'd probably like to do a takoyaki stall.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And it won't have octopus in them, but a whole bunch of stuff! So what you get inside will be all up to chance♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds fun...! But I'd have to work up the courage to eat them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No octopus? Can you even call them “takoyaki” at that point...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about you, MEIKO? My guess is a cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I'm used to, and it'd probably go pretty well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it could be fun to try something completely new for a change.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
How about you, Rin, Len?
What would you two do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... It's gotta be that, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, given the choice, it's really gotta be that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what would “that” be?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That would be...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A cotton candy stall!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew you'd say the same thing, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course! I mean, there's no way spinning your own cotton candy isn't gonna be fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. Oh, cotton candy.
That suits you both so well!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Does that mean you think we're being childish?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, not at all! I was just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm suddenly feeling parched.
MEIKO, I'd like some orange juice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
He's gonna make a run for it!
Rin, you go around that way!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
You're not getting away from us, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, great teamwork, you two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, even after all this talk about the School Festival nearly causing them to fight.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha. Isn't that wonderful, KAITO?
You helped them make up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
P-Please, everyone!
Stop laughing and lend me a hand!
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Main Gate

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, Haruka, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Homeroom dragged on for—huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hey, no worries♪
We kept ourselves occupied by watching a video!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Rin, you're already here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! You guys are buying some stuff for Len and me, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for coming on such short notice. We're getting some cake and other things to mark the occasion, and we figured we should find out what you want to have.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Cake! I wonder what kinds they have? Now you've really got my attention!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, you said you were in the middle of watching something. What was it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since the teaser for Rin and Len's anniversary show dropped recently, we decided to check it out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that! It has some behind-the-scenes snippets weaved in there, too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to admit, I haven't seen it yet, but I was meaning to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You're missing out! The show's tomorrow, you have to watch it today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Uh-huh♪ Since it's quite short, how about we watch it now?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And take up your valuable time? Well, if you're sure. I wanna watch it too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see. Where's my phone...?
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hello everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's Kagamine Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And Kagamine Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you guys know what makes December 27th so special?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's our anniversary! And what's a better way to celebrate than with an anniversary show?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ding, ding, ding! And we'll be the ones performing♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ahaha! We'll be giving you a sneak peek behind the scenes as we prep for the big day!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Without further ado, let's begin♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Just look at their beaming faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like they're beside themselves waiting for their anniversary to come.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe. As it turns out, Len and I were getting things ready for our show in SEKAI just before I arrived here!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So seeing these versions of us doing the same thing has me all excited!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: From what Rin was telling Minori and me earlier, it sounds like everything's coming together quite nicely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've also got our own roles to fulfill in all this, so let's give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After all, we're doing this for Rin and Len, who have always been there for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nicely said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like that time I had snapped at Shizuku and was feeling sad. It was Rin who came to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then there was another time when the stress of whether to sign up to an agency got to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is there some kind of rule that says idols have to be part of one of these agencies you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take this SEKAI, for example. All of these different stages were created through everyone's feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You have as many wonderful feelings here, so I feel like you'd be capable of anything if you put your minds to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The four of you are sure to become an idol group that can give hope to anyone, anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's what I believe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin gave me the boost I desperately needed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And when we were going to have our first ever joint show, she was there for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others are so great at being idols and I wanted to be just like them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew that it wouldn't be easy either...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it feels like nothing I do is working. It feels like I'm never gonna be able to become a real idol like them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand how you feel!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku and Luka are so amazing at singing and dancing, and they never make any mistakes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I always feel like I'm the one that's holding them back sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I keep hoping that I'll be like them someday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When she told me that she was also going through the same thing, it gave me such a sense of relief.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it's not just that. It gave me so much courage too! Now's the time to pay her back by putting every ounce of our energy into this show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehehe...
Gosh, guys... I feel like you're speaking so highly of me.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's because we are, silly. We're not exaggerating when we say you've done so much for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I feel like Rin's the kind of person who lights up every room she walks in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we go to SEKAI, her excited voice is enough to draw us to where she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! The trail always leads to Rin and the others!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! The difference Rin makes to the atmosphere is like night and day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I-I dunno...
That sounds a bit too good to be true...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I'm happy you feel that way about me♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, how do you guys think our show is shaping up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Watching Miku and Luka lose their minds trying to find the end of a suuuper long cable was so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They almost never lose their cool, so their confused faces were a rare sight!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And that wraps up today's video! Hope you enjoyed it!♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin and I each have our own part for the show, and we can't wait to deliver our jam-packed program!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: We hope to see you then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ah! What an exciting teaser!
It really gave us a taste of each of the different segments we can look forward to!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, now we really can't miss out on this Rin and Len's show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We sure can't! But in the meantime, that shopping won't do itself!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, we should probably go preorder the cake first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we should buy a ton of snacks and juice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Eep! I'm so excited for the party tomorrow♪>
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

Hello to everyone in the audience!
And hello to everyone joining us on the stream!

The fun's about to begin!
Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I sure am!>
<I was ready three hours ago!>
<I've been looking forward to this, Rin!>

Ah, it looks like our livestream viewers are raring to go♪
That means it's time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Put your hands together for the Kagamine Rin and Kagamine Len Special Anniversary Show! Time to get started with my part!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, hello everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can't forget you guys on this side too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And finally, our livestream viewers! Yoo-hoo! Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So ready!>
<What's she gonna sing?>
<So excited! Not sure I can last the whole show!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha. Rin, the show's only just started! Isn't this a bit over the top?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nope, this is the hype we need! Don't forget, all these people came here to celebrate our anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm going to make the most of this opportunity to talk directly to all our fans, near and far, while we put on an incredible show for them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I was wondering why your rehearsals included sessions to practice waving and talking to the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We've gotta go all out today and really give our fans what they came for♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, who knows? Maybe their hearts will all melt for me by curtain call!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just look. The venue is flooded with fans who came especially to see you and Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the looks of things, everyone's hearts have already melted.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? In that case, we'll need to set the bar even higher...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How about...a total Rin meltdown!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sounds like you have a lot in store!
Anyway, shall we get started soon?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Alright you guys, time to raise the roof!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now for our opening number!
Start the music♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for listening!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't believe we've reached the last song already.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yup, even as the ones performing, we've been having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before we perform our final song, let's read out our anniversary wishes to Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin!
The amount of passion and excitement you give me never ceases to surprise me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I'm brimming with energy—enough to give some back. Getting to sing with you is all I could ever ask for. Looking forward to all our future gigs!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, happy anniversary. You never fail to put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You have a mischievous streak, but that's what makes you so lovable. Please don't lose it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! Happy anniversary! I guess there's not much to say since we're always together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But let's not forget we've got Miku and the others, and all our supportive fans to thank for everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's remember that support as we venture through one more year!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your contagious laugh always puts me in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So please don't stop smiling... Just remember, the party snacks are for everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, happy anniversary! Your ability to light up any room leaves me in admiration.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We promise to make sure that smile of yours stays bright, so please tell us if there's anything we can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All together now...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! This is gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you guys! And to all of you who came to see us today, too. From the bottom of my heart, thank you so, so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It seems I have a knack for raising people's spirits when they're feeling low.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't even realize I was doing it. Hehe, now I'm lost for words...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: As Len said, it's thanks to the support of all of you here today that we're able to continue doing what we do best.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here's to all of us for many years to come!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's time for the last song of my part!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope you'll all join in and sing with me♪
