rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This year's almost over.
It went by like a flash, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it did. We were able to put on quite a few shows, and got to see Tsukasa and the others grow as a troupe. A wonderful year all in all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ And we got to see a bunch of really amazing shows from them too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Miku! Everyone!
Wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Emu! You guys! Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What brings you all here today?
Are you practicing for a show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, we came to say hi since the year's about to end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our plan is to do this again when everybody's gathered, but since you're here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
KAITO, Miku, Rin...
We appreciate everything you've done for us this past year.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you as well. We too enjoyed everything that happened this past year.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep doing lots and lots more fun shows next year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which!
Are you guys gonna do a New Year's show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We already have a plan for that and just began practicing for it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! That's so cool! What's it about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know too♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Before we tell you, we need to introduce you to someone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Who?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
C'mon on over! Don't be shy!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Lion Dance Robot!
Long time no see! How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He's very happy today because it's been so long since he last saw all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, while I've already had my head chomped on twice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! Twice?! Oh, hang on...
You sound happy about that, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, that's because it's a sign of good luck.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. It's supposed to absorb all of your bad luck when it bites your head, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. It's also good luck in the sense that the Japanese words “bite” and “god” work as a pun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The same goes for a “sign of good luck” and “great acting”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Then, Lion Dance Robot chomping on you means you'll become a better actor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now you're just stretching your luck.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Isn't that the point of these sorts of things? Right, Lion Dance Robot?!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. He seems really happy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, he certainly does.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He'll be starring in the New Year's show that we just mentioned, so we'd like you to wish him luck.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
He will?!
So that's why you brought him here today!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP! CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Do you want to play with us?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's play!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rui, mind if we play with him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not at all, please do.
But I would like to introduce him to Len at some point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
MEIKO and Luka too.
We still need to thank them for what they did for us this past year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They should be at the stage right now, so why don't we head over?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet Len's gonna love it when he sees you, Lion Dance Robot! After that, let's all play!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others put on such a fun series of New Year's shows☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ On top of a mountain, at the mall...! We had to stay hidden while we watched, but they were all really exciting.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they were! Each time I heard them sing, I had to do everything I could to stay quiet and not sing along.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know what you mean. As much as it would've been nice to see how their audiences reacted, I think we got a good understanding of how everything went.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I feel the same way.
It sounded like everybody had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Hang on a second. Luka, you were dozing off the whole time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She was, but she probably heard them since she seemed to have no trouble nodding in time with the music.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, I heard them just fine.
Remember how they shouted, “Ahh-ahah-ahah,” in the end as they swung through the jungle?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: That never happened!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha... I knew it. You definitely dreamed some of that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hearing the audience laugh and have fun must've been a nice lullaby to fall asleep to.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Lion Dance Robot seemed to have a lot of fun too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. From what I understand, all of those shows were also meant for him since he doesn't get to make many appearances outside of New Year's...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right♪ It was so nice of them to do that for him!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, that's just who they are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you think Lion Dance Robot had his fill of fun?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure he did since all their shows went so well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. I hope they do more shows with Lion Dance Robot next New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Rin, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So... That means we won't get to see Lion Dance Robot again for a while...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
Sadly, he's specifically a “Lion Dance” Robot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We all have different traits and personalities, but can play a bunch of different roles, though?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Isn't there a way to have Lion Dance Robot do stuff other than what he was originally intended for?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hmm... I see...
I think I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, Tsukasa and the others are members of Phoenix Wonderland's cast, so producing a show for Lion Dance Robot each time won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But we may be able to come up with some show ideas for him.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We can think of some clever ways to make it so Lion Dance Robot can be in lots more shows!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, couldn't Lion Dance Robot play something strong and powerful, like a dragon?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally☆
He's really good at wiggling and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. If we give him a swim ring and a lei, he would be perfectly ready for the summer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A swim ring? A lei is one thing, but it'll depend on the type of show you're doing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wiggling is his forte, so he might make a good hula dancer, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Seeing Lion Dance Robot do different dances based on the season could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna go tell Rui about this. Can I?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go with you.
We can ask him about this together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna go too!
It'd be great to do more shows with Lion Dance Robot!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me three☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, I think I'll join you all.
Especially since it means we'll get to do a show with him if we receive the okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'd also like to go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree that it would be nice to do more shows with Lion Dance Robot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, let's go talk to them!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lalala♪ Lala♪ La♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? What was that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, it's a fragment of a feeling!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, I wonder what kind of feeling this was born from.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh...? What is this...?
It feels like something is calling me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is...a fragment, right?
So why do the emotions feel so strong...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: At times like these, it's best to follow your instincts and go take a look!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna pop in for a bit on the owner of these feelings!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here I am♪ Wait, whoa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What is this TV thing?!
Len and I are singing on it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And there's all these circles and Xs flying around in time with the music! Hahaha, that's so fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! There's a bunch of our CDs and merch over here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean the owner of these feelings is a fan of ours? Hehehe, that makes me pretty happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But... What is this place?
There's stuff to play with, so it doesn't seem like a CD shop...
Is someone there...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Amazing...! It's Rin!
I really like you and Len's songs!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I can't believe I'm having a dream like this...
I wonder if it's because I went to sleep listening to one of your songs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Is he the owner of this fragment of a feeling?)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Um, uhh...!
I—

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Cough* *Cough*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa! A-Are you okay?
Maybe sit down over here?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Sorry I surprised you...
I'm sick, so I've been here for the longest time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...this is a hospital?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah... Oh, but it's a bit different from usual.
Maybe because this is a dream...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Then that means he really is the owner of the feelings making this fragment's SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Dreams sure are nice...
In real life, I can't get out of bed by myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So it's a tough illness...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
It's complicated, and I don't really get it...
But they say that ever since I was born, these parts of me called my lungs haven't worked right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Since you were born? So when you said you've been here for the longest time...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Even for elementary school, I was only able to go for the entrance ceremony...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry. This is pretty boring to listen to, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Not at all. I'm the one who asked, so don't worry about that, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh yeah, there sure are a lot of CDs and merch of me and Len!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: My dad said that a long time ago, he used to have you and Len sing songs he wrote.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: He doesn't write music anymore, but he still really likes you both, so he has lots of your CDs and tells me about all kinds of songs.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I don't have anything to do in the hospital, so I'm always listening to your songs.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: That gives me a lot of energy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see! Hehehe, that makes me happy♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, which of our songs do you like?
I wanna hear about them, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Sure! So, this is one my dad told me about, but there's a song with these really great sounds that remind me of a video game!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: It's not just me, Hii also—

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I remembered that my friend and I had a fight...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean that Hii you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I want to make up with her...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But I... I lied to her for so long...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What...? So your fight...
Did she find out you were lying to her?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
She was so angry...
She said that she won't come to the hospital anymore... That she won't sing anymore...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Sob* *Sniffle*

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Sniffle*
...
*Cough* *Splutter*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay?! Just breathe slow, okay?
I'll rub your back.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Sniffle* I'm sorry, Hii...
I...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Would you mind telling me more about Hii?
I want to help think of a way for you two to make up.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What...? You mean it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I think that's the reason we met like this.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, so Hii lives across from your house.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah... Back when my illness wasn't this bad, we used to play at my house a lot.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: We'd also listen to you and Len's songs together, and Hii started to love you guys just like I do...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Ever since we started elementary school, she'd come to visit and sing your songs for me every day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Every day?! Wow...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't have any friends other than her, so it made me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But she only came to see me every day because I lied.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So... What did you lie about?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I told her that my sickness gets better when I listen to her sing...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: At first, I just said that it felt much easier to breathe, or that I was able to finish all of my food, things like that...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But then I started saying all kinds of other stuff, like telling her my test results were getting better, or that I might be able to go to school if I kept getting better...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I wanted to see her...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Mom and Dad would come every day...
But... I wanted to see her, too...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Now that she's in elementary school, she tells me about these new friends she's making...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But... I'm scared that the kids at school are going to take her away...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, you ended up lying to her...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But my illness hasn't gotten any better...
And now I'm going overseas to have the doctors there help me.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: They said once I go, I might not be able to come back until I get better...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: And Hii heard about it from her mom...

rows.Speaker: Hii
rows.Line: You said you feel better when I sing!

rows.Speaker: Hii
rows.Line: I wanted to go to school with you...!

rows.Speaker: Hii
rows.Line:
You're such a liar!
I... I'm never singing again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And she really did stop coming...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I can really understand why he lied...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (To him, Hii is an irreplaceable friend.)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Hii really loves to sing...
But... She said she's never singing again!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What do I do if she starts to hate singing because of me...?!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You'll have more trouble breathing if you start to cry, you know...?
It's okay... It's all right...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Sniffle*
I'm sorry, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't apologize. Thank you for telling me all this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You look like you're in pain...
How about you lie down in that bed over there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you stand?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Um, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What do you think I should do to make up with Hii...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
First, you have to apologize for lying.
Then, you should also tell her why you lied.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think you two will be able to make up if you tell her how precious a friend she is to you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Do you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But, I'm sick...
When we play together, all we can do is stay inside and play games or listen to music...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: If she plays with the kids at school, there'll be a lot more stuff she can...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you don't talk to Hii first, you won't know how she feels about that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, you need to tell her how much energy you got thanks to her singing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And... I also want you to ask her what she was thinking about when she was singing for you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You got energy from her singing, right?
That means she put some really powerful feelings into it, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I'm pretty sure there's another reason she got angry, not only because you lied.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
There's so much I have to tell her...
And so much I have to ask her, too.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But... I've never fought with a friend before...
How am I supposed to apologize?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... When I've had a fight with Len, the first thing I say is, “I'm sorry. Let's make up.”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh...? Is that enough?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm sure it will be!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think the most important thing is that you feel sorry and want to make up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you still worried?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Sorry, you're helping me so much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's alright. When you have a fight with someone precious to you, it hurts a lot, and you feel sad and uneasy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
If you want...
How about getting me to help you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Though, when I say “me”, I mean a Rin that you create.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh? A Rin that I...create?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. If you can't express it well through words, put your apology into song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Your dad used to make songs with me, right?
So, you can ask him to teach you how.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
B-But I've never even used a computer before...
There's no way I can write a song...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Maybe not a whole song.
But you can write a phrase or a melody!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Try really putting your feelings into it.
How you're sorry, and you want to make up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll take those feelings and deliver them to Hii for you!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, it looks like it's time to wake up.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
What...?! W-Wait, Rin!
I...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe, don't worry, okay?
I'll always be watching over your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Go, go, go! Y-U-T-O!
You can do it, you can do it, Yuuuto!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh! My name...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe that you can do it!
I know you can, Yuto!
Hospital Room

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line: Ngh... Oh, Dad?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Good morning, Yuto. Mom and I came to stay the night here after we heard you had an episode.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Your eyes are pretty red...
Were you crying about what happened with Hii again?

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
Yeah... And then it got hard to breathe...
I cried a lot in my dreams, too...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I see... I'm sorry, this all happened because we didn't know anything when we told her mom about your transfer.

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line: No... It's my fault for lying...

First, you have to apologize for lying.
Then, you should also tell her why you lied.

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's right... In that dream, I...

Try really putting your feelings into it.
How you're sorry, and you want to make up.
I'll take those feelings and deliver them to Hii for you!

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
...!
That's right, I have to...

rows.Speaker: Yuto
rows.Line:
Dad, I want to make a song!
Teach me how Rin works!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
His fragment of a feeling disappeared...
Was I able to give him a little push?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really, I'm only supposed to watch over the owner of the feelings, but... Since those two love me and Len so much, I couldn't just leave them be♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Plus, that SEKAI might have brought us together because it sensed his calls for help.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really hope he'll hang in there...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Actually, no. I know he'll do fine!
Alright, I'll cheer him on from here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Go, go, go!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope Ichi and the girls get here soon. They said that they're gonna practice the same song they did yesterday, so I...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Hona! Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Rin.
I'm looking forward to another good practice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Same here.
Oh, wanna head over to the classroom now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, sure. I actually have some news for you, so I'll tell you about it on the way over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Then, let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what did you wanna tell me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Remember the person I mentioned before? Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, the person you cook and clean for?
You're worried about her because she's been pushing herself kinda hard, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but she's agreed to go to the bridal fair with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Way to go, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I have you to thank, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Don't you have to actually ask her to know if she's interested?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, and... If she seems unsure, you can always try giving her an extra nudge!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Well, it would be a problem if they're really against going or something... But sometimes it's better to spur someone on if they're undecided!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <When KAITO or anyone else has something on their mind, I sometimes ask them to hang out and get a change of pace. They usually say they can't make an immediate decision...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But if I'm really persistent, they tend to be glad that they agreed to hang out in the end♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I actually invited Ms. Yoisaki, I was able to do so by being a little more persistent than usual.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Hehe. That means I get an assist!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I'm really glad for Hona! She seems so happy right now!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here♪
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, you're here early! Are you already getting stuff set up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I finished my practice and didn't have anything else to do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting me on that walk the other day...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, when I asked if you wanted to go on one for a change?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I was told a little about that as well.
You seemed to have something on your mind that time, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought I was happy with how I'd been playing this one part, but it suddenly hit me that it didn't sound quite right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I tried thinking about it on my own since it would've been hard to describe how I felt about it personally.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That was when Rin invited me to go on a walk around the schoolyard.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha...
In retrospect, I sorta forced you to...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I felt a little better as a result...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was even able to figure out a new way to play that part, and it sounds the way I want it to now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You were...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Aww, you're making me blush.
I mean, all I did was invite you to go on a quick walk.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Breathing the air outside...
Laughing may've also played a role...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha! Are you talking about when I sneezed?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you sneezed?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When we were walking around, this leaf came off this tree and fell towards my face. My nose started feeling itchy and I gave a big sneeze.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, the same leaf flew into the air, spun its way around me, landed on my face and made me sneeze again.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That was very funny.
I couldn't believe how elegantly it twirled its way around you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, KAITO, you're giggling! You're replaying what happened in your head, aren't you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry, but it was very funny...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
I wish I'd been there to see that happen.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Hona...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Honami
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I guess you were able to figure out how to play that part thanks to me! You should show your appreciation for me more, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...? But I thanked you a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I wanna hear you say it more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd rather not...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehehe.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that was good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're done!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Which means...
It's time for that♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, finally♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I thought you guys were kidding...
We're really gonna have a mock wedding?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course! You all heard about what happened at the bridal fair, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got to see where it took place, but I didn't really get to see the wedding bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, Hona asked if I wanted to do one!
She even made me a veil!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, a veil?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, it's so pretty and silky and sparkly...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. These sorts of delicate fabrics are supposed to be very hard to work with, but you've done a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
It's mostly just some lace attached to the base fabric, really. The ones you normally see are a little too intricate for me to handle.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! But it looks gorgeous! I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin. I'm glad you think so.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, how are we actually doing this mock wedding? Honami, I heard you and the others got to be in a show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A whole show might be a bit much for us, so I think giving the vows will be enough.

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Line: Do you take one another as wedded spouses for better, for worse, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish from this day forth...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho?

rows.Line: Haha! Hona, you're so popular!

rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Speaker: Miku

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, don't give me that!

rows.Speaker: Rin

rows.Line:
Agreed! So, later, you guys!
We'll see you all tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Line: MEIKO, you there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, Len, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you two run over here? What's the hurry?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Guess what?

rows.Line:
*Sigh*

rows.Line:
N-Now I remember...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, can't you guys hold off on singing until later?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As much as we'd like to...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Line: Please feel free to eat or make whatever you like. There should be plenty of snacks and drinks to go around.

rows.Line: But promise me that neither of you will try to use the stove by yourselves. And be sure to clean up afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we promise!

rows.Line: That just leaves how to set everything up for watching videos. Come with me, you two.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it!
Everything's set up for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't forget to come watch if singing practice with Luka ends early or something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, we will.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me neither!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Th-This is the real Taiga...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'd heard that he was an incredible performer, but...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I suppose this is what it means to be a world-class singer...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They're in trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(But... What do I do...?
I can't think of anything to say...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Goodbye.
This team was fun while it lasted...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh no...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, but...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They put on such an amazing event just the other day. Their third event was that unbelievably good...)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'm not gonna lie. This feels like the end of the line...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I honestly didn't want to see things end like this...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But I think it's time that I grew up and gave up on this dream...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<H-Hey, Miku...!
Isn't there anything we can do...?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <There's nothing we can do right now...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wh-What are you saying...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Y-Yeah...!
If we don't do something, they'll...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh? KAITO?! What are you doing?! Let go of me...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We can try consoling them however we like, but I doubt anything we could say would help them right now...>

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Sorry, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Miku, KAITO, why aren't you guys...?!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Calm down, Rin...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <How do you expect me to be calm right now?! At this rate, their team's gonna break up for good...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Even if we were to go out there...
Even if we were able to stop them from leaving somehow... It wouldn't mean anything.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Their friends need to be the ones to do that.>
There you are!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, isn't that An's dad...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We should stay to see what happens...>

rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Line: When I felt overwhelmed with pain, I heard Miku singing... Her voice felt so warm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (That reminds me of how Ena said she felt better after hearing me sing...)

rows.Line: Does that mean you came here to hear Miku sing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, wanna go find her...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, that's okay...

rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you already make those fixes to the demo we talked about...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. That didn't actually take very long.

rows.Line: Ena and Mizuki should also be here soon, so I'd like it if you could all listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems a little better now compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(But...
I wish I could've sung for her...)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been watching you this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been watching me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! The way you express yourself through singing is so great! And you have such a beautiful voice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, since we're here together like this, let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet we'd sound amazing if we sang together right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I wonder if she's listening to me sing right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh, sorry... I didn't mean to bother you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you need something...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I heard you singing and decided to move closer so I can hear better...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Rin? Is it me or have you changed your singing style a little...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think it's just you... Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... Lately, when I've been hearing you sing, your voice has had this warmth to it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-I'm not saying that it wasn't warm before! It's just... It's more obvious now, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I really like it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, Rin?
What do you think I should do in order to sing like you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What you should do...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Was there really no inspiration for you changing your singing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Inspiration...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rin...?
Your cheeks seem really red for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're imagining things...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
More importantly, Len...
How would you feel after meeting someone who's you, but not you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are you talking about that other Rin you met? The one you said was all shiny and cheerful?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How would you feel if you met another you with a completely different personality?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I dunno... Surprised, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'd want to learn more about him, so it'd be great if we could talk...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even if he tried to get really up close and personal while grinning the entire time?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hang on, Rin... Did you feel embarrassed when you spoke to your other self?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
...
A little...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If she made even you feel shy, I'm not sure if I'd be able to have a real conversation with my other self...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd still want to talk to him because I'd want to learn more about who he is.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really...?
Um, good for you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, Rin...
What made you want to talk about her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I felt like it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, so... Is the inspiration behind your singing voice sounding warmer now that you got to meet your other self?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Who knows? I can't really tell what's changed if anything has.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-But I figured you told me all about this other Rin because you thought that she—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Pipe down now...
That's enough talking.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's finally quiet again...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It doesn't feel like anything's changed...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But I guess I don't mind at all if my voice sounds warmer.)
Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Welcome back to another episode of “Get on Those Hot Topics!”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
We have another guest visiting us today!
Here she is!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <All the people I've never met, and the ones I haven't seen in too long, hi there! I'm Kagamine Rin♪>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you for that energetic self-introduction!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: You'll be participating in the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show that's going to be held in Shibuya, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's right! We're all working hard to get ready and make it a fun show♪>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you very much for taking the time out of your busy schedule to come see us.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to tell our viewers a little bit about Rin.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Kagamine Rin is a VIRTUAL SINGER who sings the songs of different creators, much like Hatsune Miku.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Her sparkling golden hair and big cute ribbon are quite iconic, wouldn't you say?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: The ribbon looks so great on you! Did you style it yourself?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I did! Oh, but since I was gonna be on TV today, I had to ask Luka to check and make sure it wasn't crooked.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
Ah, Megurine Luka!
Hehe, I can see that wholesome scene now.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: But! Just what sort of impression do people have of the adorable Rin here with us today?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Surely you're curious as well, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Extremely!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I was so curious, I searched through the script I got for today to see if it wasn't written there.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. Well in that case, I'll read out some messages we've received on that very topic.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: This first one is from a junior high school student in Tokyo.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: She says, “I love Rin's cheerful, adorable voice. She has lots of funny songs too, and I always have a good time listening to them.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We also received this impassioned message from a woman currently attending university.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “Rin is cute usually, but when I see her singing more grown-up, passionate songs, my heart can't help but start racing!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, good! I didn't know what I was gonna do if people were talking about how weird I am or something.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. Every message was full of Rin love, I assure you.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Wow, we even have a message from a boy who's moved away from Japan and is now living abroad.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
It reads, “Dear Rin,
When I got into a fight with my close friend, we were able to make up because you sang for us. Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I'm glad things turned out okay!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. I also get into fights with Len sometimes, but I always make sure to set things right. I hope I can keep being a source of support.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: How reassuring! By the way, Rin, how do you set things right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <When we've had a regular fight, I think we usually both apologize the next time we see each other...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <When it's a bigger fight, I talk to Miku and the others about it...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <If I was in the wrong, they always tell me exactly what I did wrong, which really helps.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It's wonderful that you have friends who'll talk things out with you so earnestly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe, I think so too!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Well, that's about all the time we have.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you for speaking with us today, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No, thank you! This was fun!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Lastly, can we get a word for all of our viewers?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks for watching my interview today! It made me so happy to get all those messages♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I hope I can give you just as much happiness in return during the show!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, please come see us if you can!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Rin, thank you very much for today!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We'll be continuing with the next in our series of VIRTUAL SINGER interviews tomorrow! And with that...
